title: Chapter 31 The Arrival Of The First-Level Galaxy
content:
Chapter 31 The Arrival Of The First-Level Galaxy

So, this scene appeared in the starry sky of Tianxuan World.

The strongest force in Tianxuan World, Huangcheng, fought against the strongest forces from all over the Hongmeng Universe.

In the starry sky.

Facing the absolute crushing of numbers, the people in Huangcheng did not show any fear in their eyes.

Instead, they were full of vigor.

Yunqi stood proudly in front of the Lu family army, and his aura was much stronger than the last battle. Looking at this foreign force, Yunqi's eyes were full of endless murderous intent.

He had been fighting almost all his life.

His hands were stained with countless blood.

He was never afraid of war.

In his opinion, the enemy should be killed.

"This time, I won't let you run away again."

Hearing Yunqi's words, the Xieyun Sect and Tianjian Sect in the back trembled for some reason, and their bodies trembled unconsciously.

"How dare you attack my deserted city!"

"Kill!"

Without any extra words, the strong men in the deserted city rushed towards the enemy.

In an instant, the drums of war were beating, the momentum was surging, and the sound of fighting resounded through the world.

Everyone tried their best.

Looking at the strength of the strong men in the deserted city, the people from the major forces outside were all shocked.

They knew that they underestimated this low-level galaxy.

The force in front of them had the strength that was not weaker than any of their forces.

But that was all.

Besides, it has come to this point, can we just leave directly?

It is obviously impossible.

"Don't be afraid, we have many people, kill them, and those treasures will be ours!"

Suddenly, the forces no longer hesitated and rushed forward.

In front of those supreme treasures, no force could resist the temptation.

Boom!

The powerful force continued to pour down, and the entire starry sky began to crack inch by inch under the powerful force.

It must be said that the people trained by Lu Daosheng are indeed extremely powerful.

Each of them is a one-to-ten existence.

Yunqi alone fought with six beings in the same ancient realm, and he was suppressing them.

On the other side, Gu Chen was not weak at all. No one in the field could stop Gu Chen.

Boom!

Another huge explosion sounded.

An unparalleled force rushed directly to Gu Chen in the crowd.

Suddenly, Gu Chen's face changed, and his arms were crossed in front of him to resist.

With a bang.

Gu Chen retreated thousands of feet away, and the entire starry sky was directly shattered, which shows his strong power.

"Unknown realm."

Gu Chen looked at the figure in the distance with a solemn expression.

That's right, it was an unknown realm strongman, a terrifying existence from a first-level galaxy.

Seeing the unknown realm strongman take action, the major forces outside were surprised and happy.

Unexpectedly, even the unknown realm strongman took action.

It seems that the other party wants to end the battle as soon as possible.

Suddenly, everyone began to fight desperately.

At this time, the unknown realm strongman was also looking at Gu Chen with cold eyes.

"Do you think you are strong? If you don't enter the unknown, you will eventually be an ant."

The unknown realm strongman said coldly.

At this time, Huang Shou appeared beside Gu Chen.

"Are you okay?"

Gu Chen shook his head.

"I'll deal with it."

However, Gu Chen still shook his head.

"Let me do it myself."

Hearing this, Huang Shou hesitated a little, but nodded.

"Then you be careful."

"Okay."

Then, Gu Chen rushed up again.

Seeing this scene, the unknown realm strongman in the distance looked sarcastic.

"An ant trying to shake a tree doesn't know how high the sky is and how thick the earth is."

"Well, then let me show you what the power of the unknown realm is."

Then, he punched again.

And this punch was much stronger than the last time.

In the distance, Gu Chen slowly closed his eyes, and a unique power emanated from his body.

"The world helps me."

The next moment, an incredible scene appeared.

In the Tianxuan world below, countless powers of heaven and earth began to pour into Gu Chen's body. At the same time, Gu Chen's breath continued to rise.

Soon, he was not weaker than the unknown realm strongman.

Seeing this scene, the eyes of all forces were filled with fear.

"Stop him!"

Suddenly, the unknown realm strongman did not dare to be careless and rushed directly towards Gu Chen.

Wherever he passed, the starry sky continued to shatter.

And the one who attacked Gu Chen was not only the unknown realm strongman, but also another unknown realm strongman from the first-level galaxy.

Facing the attacks of the two unknown realms, Gu Chen looked indifferent.

"Too late."

Boom!

A powerful breath rushed up from Gu Chen's body.

Inexhaustible power continued to surge out of Gu Chen's body.

"Die!"

Boom!

Gu Chen punched out with endless world power, and blasted towards the two unknown realm masters.

Suddenly, the two unknown realm masters retreated madly, and retreated tens of thousands of feet away.

Hiss~

Suddenly, countless sounds of sucking in cold air came from the starry sky.

"Hahaha, Brother Gu did a great job!"

Inside the deserted city below.

"Wow! Dad, how come Master suddenly became so powerful?"

Lu Xue looked at Gu Chen in the sky, with stars in her eyes.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Your master is a native of the Tianxuan World. Moreover, he sacrificed himself to suppress the evil demons and protect the entire Tianxuan World. This should be the favor of the Tianxuan World."

"What does it mean?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was a little confused.

"Well, simply put, your master is the destined person in the Tianxuan world."

Suddenly, Lu Xue nodded in a daze.

And at this time in the starry sky.

Gu Chen has become an invincible existence.

No one could stop him.

For a time, major forces began to retreat step by step.

Just as the forces had the idea of retreating, another terrifying aura suddenly sounded from the field.

At the same time, a huge space-time crack surged out at the border of the Xuangu galaxy.

The next moment, a huge warship slowly emerged from it.

Two powerful words are engraved on the battleship flag.

eternal!

......

"What's going on?"

"It seems like another level 1 galaxy is coming."

"Is that so good."

"What a f*ck. There are so many first-level galaxies, so how can we get our second-level galaxies? We can only get a bargain."

Suddenly, the forces reacted, feeling a little crying without tears.

The main reason is that they did not expect that this former fourth-level galaxy would have such strength.

If the first-level galaxy doesn't take action, it really won't be able to deal with them.

The next moment, a tall tower slowly came from the depths of the starry sky.

"It's the Uranus system!"

An extremely powerful first-class galaxy.

It is no exaggeration to say that Uranus is stronger than all the galaxies present combined.

At this time, the tower stopped.

Several strong men slowly stepped out of it.

The three unknown realm powerhouses, the rest are ancient realm powerhouses.

Such strength is simply terrifying.

These strong men from the Uranus system did not look at anyone present, but looked straight at the deserted city below.

They saw one thing that everyone ignored.

The real treasures are not only those in the giant city, but also the giant city.

The entire giant city is an incredible treasure.

With endless greed in his eyes, the person in charge said coldly: "This city belongs to my Uranus system."

"ah?"

Suddenly, everyone around was stunned.

They worked so hard to get nothing?

"What, you don't agree?"

Suddenly, a powerful aura surged out of the bodies of the Uranus powerful people.

In an instant, the entire starry sky began to break.

Obviously, it can't hold on to the aura of these strong men.

Hearing these extremely arrogant words, none of the forces in the surrounding galaxies dared to speak out.

Seeing this, everyone in the Uranus system sneered and then walked towards the deserted city.

"Now, those who surrender will not be killed."

Ga~

There was an awkward atmosphere in the field.

The people in Huangcheng looked at the Uranus system with a look like a fool.

They all looked a little red.

With a cold snorkeling, the Uranus powerhouse continued, "Since you don't surrender, then die!"

"Haha, do you really think that there is no one in my deserted city?"

In the distance, clouds burst into cold voices.

"oh?"

The next moment, Yun Qi burst out his breath directly.

Unknown realm!

That's right, since the last battle, Lu Daosheng has improved Yun Qi a little more.

Now, Yunqi has also reached an unknown state.

"What!"

"How is this possible!"

In this Xuan Gu Galaxy, there have been powerful people from unknown realm.

That means that the Xuan Gu Galaxy is now a first-level galaxy.

It's ridiculous that a group of second-level galaxies actually invaded a first-level galaxy.

In the back, when the Xieyun Sect and the Tianjian Sect saw this scene, their souls were almost scared away.

"Retreat, retreat quickly!"

Suddenly, the two forces retreated in a hurry.

"Haha, I want to leave now, it's too late."

Yun Qi saw the Evil Yun Sect and the Giant Sword Sect who wanted to escape.

boom!

A huge palm mixed with endless power from the unknown realm crushed towards the two forces of the Evil Cloud Sect and the Giant Sword Sect.

No force around dares to stop it.

In just a moment, the two forces were directly destroyed.

This is the horror of the unknown.
